vendor_macro_limitation.disposition: Do not treat periodic large-signal timeout as hardware overload. Use the controlled macro for AC and operating point. Fast load/capacitance transient results are diagnostic/supportive only where they converge reproducibly. Quasi-static nonlinear transfer is used only through 5 Vrms input; 7.5 and 9 Vrms points produced non-physical output beyond the +/-18 V rails and are excluded. Any quasi-static distortion result is an engineering estimate, not transient 1 kHz THD, and requires bench correlation before release.

stability_model_limitation.disposition: Do not use retry-until-pass logic. Do not claim reproducible transient stability qualification from this combined vendor-model stack. Preserve the converged transient results as supportive evidence only; use exact- topology official-Murata small-signal AC evidence plus mandatory prototype load/cable stability bench verification for the qualification boundary.
